attributes.description: Overview of cloud posture and vulnerability findings reported by Upwind.

embeddableConfig.content:
This dashboard gives visibility into the configuration findings and vulnerability findings data streams of Upwind, showing cloud posture violations and vulnerabilities across accounts and workloads. It highlights open vulnerabilities, exploitable and in-use vulnerable packages, and failed configuration checks, with severity breakdowns for both finding types. It surfaces findings by cloud provider and resource type, the most violated compliance frameworks and rules, the most affected packages and CVEs, and streams of the latest findings for triage. Use the controls above to filter by cloud provider, resource type, vulnerability severity, and framework. Together, these panels offer a posture-level view to support compliance oversight, vulnerability management, and remediation prioritization.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/upwind/overview)**
